primary_generation_rows: j >= 1; speech-start prediction j=0 is an engineering/anchor diagnostic only
phase_weighting: Equal mean weight over all seven predicted phases; each utterance contributes once
position_bins: Three chronological code-frame tertiles of the inspected prefix; not word-aligned
history_subset: 10 development and 30 confirmation utterances frozen in cohort.jsonl
reference_generation: Reuse c01-c04 default and alternate ANGER histories. Generate only missing DEFAULT prompt continuations with seeds 1234/5678, original token_budget(text) and decoding settings. Save IDs; do not decode WAVs.
historical_reference: Four calibration-text prompt-anchor default-relative residual directions. Subtract the historical News direction to form each fixed News-relative reference. No new fitting on confirmation.
development_fit: Unit-normalize each phase-averaged contrast. Average across development utterances per label/site/layer/phase. Normalize the three-label consensus to rank one; residualize each style mean against it. Freeze this basis before confirmation extraction/analysis.
primary_summary_rule: Average equally over the three News-relative style contrasts, seven phases and all 28 layers (and sites only where specified). The two fixed layer indices come from prior work, not confirmation selection.
primary_tests: Two-sided one-sample t tests of utterance-level signed outcomes versus zero, Holm correction across this fixed 10-test family. Approximate inference assumes independent source documents; include stratified utterance bootstrap confidence intervals and descriptive sensitivity.
map_uncertainty: Centered standardized max-deviation bootstrap bands within each predeclared historical/shared/specificity map family; approximate simultaneous bands, not independent token tests.
M2_selection: Development only: choose one site/layer by highest shared-direction alignment and another by highest style-specific margin; choose one phase by largest development News-relative output JSD. Record all ties deterministically, freeze before confirmation. No intervention during M1.
confirmation_gate: Pilot and development engineering checks pass; basis, hypothesis shortlist and manifest hashes frozen. Never retune on confirmation.
missingness: Record every requested utterance/history and failure. No missing values assigned zero. Report complete-case and requested denominators; development fit requires >=24 complete primary histories and >=8 per category.
storage: All-position metric maps and probabilities; phase-pooled tensors on development and paired-primary histories for resume safety remain on Kedi; selective exact rows for frozen 6-development/3-confirmation IDs plus c03/c04 engineering checks. No full logits, new decoder replays or model weights exported.
limits: Instruction labels are lexical manipulations, not verified emotion delivery
News-relative controls equal format, not emotional semantics
Reference histories may be off-policy under other prompts
No per-layer token distributions are claimed
English Amit only; one checkpoint and primary seed
Text categories are operational, not psychological ground truth
No causal intervention or perceived-quality conclusion
